sentences.text: Charts also show regulated areas, usually in magenta.
Anchorage areas and special anchorage areas are outlined, and in a special anchorage area small vessels may anchor without anchor lights under Inland rules.
Cable and pipeline areas mean don’t anchor or drag gear.
Restricted areas, danger zones and security zones each have rules explained in the chart notes and the Coast Pilot.
Bridges show their type and their horizontal and vertical clearances.
Conspicuous landmarks like water tanks, radio towers, stacks and spires are useful for bearings, and a small circle on the symbol marks the exact position.
